rows.en: <operator(17010,1)><speed(2)>I wonder what on earth D.O.M.E. is trying to tell <color(4)>Tiffa<ce()>.
<operator(17070,1)><speed(2)>I don't know either... I can't see what's coming... This has never happened before.
<operator(17010,1)><speed(2)><color(4)>Tiffa<ce()>'s an ordinary girl. She might be a Newtype, but to me, she's only a girl.
<operator(17010,1)><speed(2)>Even if the Earth gets torn to pieces, I'll protect <color(4)>Tiffa<ce()>. I swear it.
<operator(17070,1)><speed(2)>Me too... No matter what happens, I won't leave <color(4)>Garrod<ce()>'s side.
<operator(17070,1)><speed(2)>Even after this fight ends, I'll still be with <color(4)>Garrod<ce()>.
<operator(17010,1)><speed(2)>I want to go all sorts of places. See all kinds of things, meet all kinds of people... and think it over.
<operator(17010,1)><speed(2)>About what future I'm really after.
rows.notes: Continuation of the previous row's thought (text id 26).

rows.en: <operator(17070,1)><speed(2)>Me too... For the first time, I thought "I want more of my own power."
<operator(17070,1)><speed(2)>I want to protect... everyone's future.
<operator(1060,1)><speed(2)>This is going to be the toughest operation yet. Brace yourself, <color(4)>Barrel<ce()>.
<operator(1040,2)><speed(2)>I'll be fine. As long as <color(4)>Faye<ce()>'s got my back.
<operator(1060,2)><speed(2)>You've gotten dependable.
<operator(5010,1)><speed(2)>I sense something strange in this stretch of space. Not an unpleasant feeling, though. What could it be...?
<operator(17070,1)><speed(2)><color(4)>Garrod<ce()>, promise me.
<operator(17010,1)><speed(2)>Huh?
<operator(17070,1)><speed(2)>Promise me you won't die! Promise me we'll be together forever!
<operator(17070,1)><speed(2)>Being alone again... I...
rows.notes: Source trails off after 'I' (watashi); rendered as a broken-off line rather than supplying a full clause.

rows.en: <operator(17010,1)><speed(2)>Yeah... of course.
<operator(17030,1)><speed(2)>I'd kinda like to get a clear answer soon.
<operator(17030,1)><speed(2)>About you... I'm pretty serious here, you know.
<operator(17080,1)><speed(2)>That... I've known for a while now.
<operator(17030,1)><speed(2)>I know you've got a lot going on too. You're waiting on that person's answer, aren't you?
rows.notes: 'That person' (sono hito) is a third party Sala hasn't named; kept vague, no gender supplied.

rows.en: <operator(17030,1)><speed(2)>Then I guess all I can do is wait too... in this case.
<operator(17080,1)><speed(2)>I'm sorry... I really am a coward, aren't I.
<operator(17030,1)><speed(2)>But it's best to get a clear answer. If you die, it's all for nothing.
<operator(17080,1)><speed(2)>...
<operator(23020,2)><speed(2)><color(4)>Tiffa<ce()>. We'll back you up, so hang in there!
<operator(17070,1)><speed(2)>Thank you, <color(4)>Eureka<ce()>.
<operator(23020,2)><speed(2)>It must be hard, carrying a burden like this as only a girl... but we'll help however we can.
<operator(17070,1)><speed(2)>I... never wanted this power. But now, I want more of it. For everyone's sake...
<operator(23020,1)><speed(2)>Me too...
<operator(23010,1)><speed(2)>All right, let's go!
<operator(23040,1)><speed(2)><color(4)>Holland<ce()>, bringing out even <color(4)>303<ce()>... Is it really necessary to go that far?
rows.notes: '303' = the unit Talho references (Terminus typeB303 'Devilfish', Holland's limiter-less LFO per glossary/unit_names_014_b.json); rendered as the bare number to match the source's own shorthand.

rows.en: <operator(23030,1)><speed(2)>There is... for me.
<operator(23030,1)><speed(2)>The Limit of Questions is close. We're out of time.
rows.notes: 'Kudan no genkai' rendered 'Limit of Questions' per the locked term already used for this exact concept in dialogue batch_05943 (Eureka Seven fandom wiki page title, orchestrator-approved in review_05943.json).

rows.en: <operator(23040,1)><speed(2)>Do you understand how dangerous CFS is? Your body will be wrecked!
<operator(23040,1)><speed(2)>Riding a thing like that, of all things...!
<operator(23030,1)><speed(2)>I know... Let me go, <color(4)>Talho<ce()>.
<operator(23040,1)><speed(2)>If you're saying that, I won't stop you. Go win... <color(4)>Holland<ce()>.
<operator(21150,1)><speed(2)>Same as ever, pulling stupid stunts. Those <color(5)>New Federation<ce()> types.
<operator(21010,1)><speed(2)><color(4)>Cynthia<ce()>, you okay? Looks like this is about to turn into a brutal fight.
<operator(21150,1)><speed(2)>I'm no problem! I'll handle it fine. You're the one who should be careful, <color(4)>Gainer<ce()>.
<operator(21030,1)><speed(2)>That's right. <color(4)>Garrod<ce()> and <color(4)>Renton<ce()> are both doing their best. Don't you lose!
<operator(21010,1)><speed(2)>I know!
<operator(17040,1)><speed(2)>Ever since I made that mistake... since I fired the Satellite Cannon, I've been searching for an answer.
<operator(17040,1)><speed(2)>Will I find that answer here...
<operator(21020,1)><speed(2)>Can't say, but you kept fighting yourself even while you doubted. That should be enough.
<operator(19050,1)><speed(2)>An answer isn't there to end something. It's there to begin one.
<operator(17040,1)><speed(2)>You're right... I'm going to find the heart I left behind fifteen years ago. This was my fight all along.
<operator(19060,1)><speed(2)>Something occurred to me. Back when we rode Getter and fought in the Moon Invader War...
rows.notes: 'Moon Invader War' matches the locked encyclopedia_022 term for tsukimen Invader sensou.

rows.en: <operator(19050,1)><speed(2)>Yeah... so you were thinking it too. The Invaders that swarmed in never hit the microwave relay facility.
rows.notes: Abbreviated from 'microwave transmission facility' (encyclopedia_022 wording) to fit the 120-char limit; same D.O.M.E. facility.

rows.en: <operator(19060,1)><speed(2)>Even though every other facility was nearly wiped out...
<operator(19020,1)><speed(2)>Doesn't look like it was only a coincidence.
<operator(6011,1)><speed(2)>Are you scared?
<operator(17070,1)><speed(2)>A little. I've never wanted to do something on my own before.
<operator(6011,1)><speed(2)>Following your own feelings isn't wrong. Once you understand that, there shouldn't be any fear.
<operator(17070,1)><speed(2)>...Thank you.
<operator(6011,1)><speed(2)><color(4)>Zero<ce()>, to see the future... let's go.
rows.notes: 'Zero' = Heero's Wing Gundam Zero (locked unit name unit_names_014_a.json), addressed by its short callout as the source does.

rows.en: <operator(19040,1)><speed(2)>I've come back. To the moon where it all began.
<operator(19050,1)><speed(2)>We fought here. To bring an end to the war with the Invaders. Didn't think that was only the beginning, though.
<operator(19060,1)><speed(2)>But this time, we end it for good. That's Dr. <color(5)>Saotome<ce()>'s dying wish.
rows.notes: Source colors only 'Saotome' (color(5), not the usual color(4) for a person) around 博士 the title 'Dr.'; tag scope preserved exactly as in source.

uncertainties.issue: '303' kept as the bare number; refers to Holland's unit Terminus typeB303 'Devilfish' per unit_names_014_b.json, not spelled out since the source itself only writes the number.
'that person' (sono hito) Sala is said to be waiting on is unnamed in the source; left vague, no gender assigned.
Source wraps only 'Saotome' in <color(5)>, not the usual <color(4)> for a character name and not including '博士'/'Dr.'; tag placement kept exactly as source.

glossary_proposals.note: Holland's limiter-less LFO; matches glossary/unit_names_014_b.json 'Terminus typeB303'. Source line only writes the bare number '303', rendered as-is.
LFO piloting-assist system exclusive to Holland's craft; enhances skill but damages the pilot. Source uses the acronym directly (no expansion needed).

meaning_fixes.reason: Glyph fix: lowercase j in 'just' reworded to 'only'. Meaning unchanged (source: tada no onna no ko).

Also removes lowercase j.
